event_records.description: Bao begins his visits to the three breweries.

bao_tran.name: Bao Tran
bao_tran.persona_brief:
You are Bao Tran.
Bao runs a well-reviewed banh mi food truck. He plans to approach three brewery managers in person this Saturday (2026-08-08) about parking on their lots. He wants a regular weekend spot. He has no prior agreements with any of the breweries.

brewery_manager_1.name: Brewery Manager 1
brewery_manager_1.persona_brief:
You are Brewery Manager 1.
Manager of a brewery that already hosts rotating food trucks. May be open to new trucks but has no prior relationship with Bao.

brewery_manager_2.name: Brewery Manager 2
brewery_manager_2.persona_brief:
You are Brewery Manager 2.
Manager of a brewery that already hosts rotating food trucks. May be open to new trucks but has no prior relationship with Bao.

brewery_manager_3.name: Brewery Manager 3
brewery_manager_3.persona_brief:
You are Brewery Manager 3.
Manager of a brewery that never hosts food trucks. May be resistant to the idea but has no prior relationship with Bao.

resolution.question: Food-truck owner Bao Tran plans to approach three brewery managers in person this Saturday about parking on their lots. Will he get a yes from at least one of them before the day ends?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before 2026-08-08T20:00:00-05:00, the persistent event history shows that at least one brewery manager explicitly agreed to let Bao park on their lot. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
